title: Foreword
author: Vijay Prashad
summary: Capitalism is not the gentle flowering of markets and machines but the brutal reorganisation of the world through conquest, enslavement and extraction. Sugar as a social relation; plantation as field and factory; profits underwriting industry; persistence of inequality; resistance. Written largely in 225-day incarceration. Term 'enslaved'.

title: The Conventional Narrative: An Overview
summary: Debunks the 'rise of the West' myth (Age of Discovery, Enlightenment, Industrial Revolution, free labour; looting/genocide/slavery airbrushed). Three airbrushed facts: Caribbean/American sugar plantations made sugar a global commodity; British capital predated Industrial Revolution; US cotton by enslaved Africans underwrote textile revolution. Sugar + enslaved people as paired commodities. Marx on expropriation. Gun-slave-money; demographic catastrophe; 'womb of iron and gold'. Triangular trade + overlooked Indian saltpetre/textiles. Originary accumulation = loot.
